extra.reason: Fixed in cli_commands/up.py: --domain pre-flight now reads rc.yml provider_config.ecs.aws_profile (and region) as defaults when CLI flags aren't passed. Regression test in tests/unit/test_cli_up.py::test_domain_preflight_uses_rcyml_aws_profile_as_default.

Fixed in cli_commands/_dispatchers.py: added _count_pg_restore_errors helper; _db_push_v2 now scans stdout+stderr for 'pg_restore: error' lines after restore + warns + exits 2 if any. Differentiates from rc-ln1 which is about benign warnings. Tests in tests/unit/test_db_push_pg_restore_errors.py (6 cases). Sentinal-repro: lost workflows_pagecapture would now surface as a clear WARNING + non-zero exit.

Fixed in compose_warnings.py: new detect_localhost_host_in_env_file detector + wired into collect_compose_warnings. Catches the sentinal pattern: env_file declares POSTGRES_HOST=localhost (or 127.0.0.1, host.docker.internal) when a compose service of that name exists. Suggests the correct Cloud Map service name. Tests in tests/unit/test_compose_warnings_localhost_env.py (7 cases).

Fixed in image/builder.py: ImageBuilder now uses Popen + line-streaming + no-progress watchdog when cache_to is set. Default RC_BUILD_NO_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT_S=300s; if buildkit goes silent for that long, kills the build + retries once without --cache-to + emits clear warning. New RC_DISABLE_BUILDCACHE=1 env var drops cache args entirely as escape hatch. Existing tests preserved (subprocess.run path unchanged for non-cache-to builds). New tests in tests/unit/test_image/test_builder_watchdog.py (3 cases). Full suite: 1538 passed.

Fixed via Framework.domain_env() + cli_v2.build_deploy_context injection. When rc.yml services.<svc>.domain is set AND the service's Dockerfile matches a framework preset (django/rails/phoenix), inject domain-aware env vars (DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS + CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, RAILS_HOSTS, PHX_HOST) UNDER the user's rc.yml.env so explicit overrides win. Tests in tests/unit/test_frameworks_domain_env.py (11 cases). Real-AWS validation today: sentinal-test.rctest.ezapps.ai admin login over HTTPS now works without manual settings.py CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS edit.

Shipped: new 'rc fix bake-bind-mount-source <service>' subcommand. Parses compose volumes, finds source bind mounts (relative host paths, skips named volumes / system mounts / data volumes), appends COPY <host> <container> to the matching Dockerfile. Local docker-compose still bind-mounts at runtime so hot-reload keeps working. Tests in tests/unit/test_fix_bake_bind.py (10 cases). Implementation: remote_compose/fix_bake_bind.py + cli_commands/fix.py. Sentinal-shaped repro now: 'rc fix bake-bind-mount-source django' → image has /app/manage.py → ECS deploy works.

Shipped: detect_stale_nginx_resolver_ip in compose_warnings.py. Plan-time scan of nginx config files for 'resolver <IP>' directives; warns when the IP doesn't match the IP derived from rc.yml.provider_config.ecs.vpc_cidr (network_base + 2). Suggests re-running rc fix nginx-conf. Tests in tests/unit/test_compose_warnings_stale_resolver.py (5 cases). Sentinal repro: a vpc_cidr change from 10.42 to 10.43 would now warn on plan instead of silently 502-ing in production.

Shipped: detect_large_build_context in compose_warnings.py. Computes per-service build-context size at plan time via os.scandir + os.walk (capped per subtree). >1GB → WARN; >5GB → ERROR. Names the heaviest top-level dirs in the message + suggests .dockerignore. Tests in tests/unit/test_compose_warnings_large_context.py (6 cases). Sentinal repro: backend/ at 6.8GB would now warn at plan time naming media (5.8GB) + venv (1GB) + suggesting .dockerignore — saves the 25-min context upload hang.

Shipped: remote_compose/heartbeat.py — context manager that emits '... <label> still running (elapsed=Ns)' every interval seconds via a daemon thread. Honors RC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_S env var. Wired into TerraformRunner.init/plan/apply/destroy AND the wait_for_steady_state loop in run_auto_on_deploy_hooks_for_path. Tests: tests/unit/test_heartbeat.py (5 cases). Full suite: 1572 passed. Sentinal pattern (9-min silent terraform apply, 5-min silent steady-state wait) now emits progress every 30s by default.

Shipped: alb.tf.j2 now uses name_prefix + lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true } on both the default ALB target group and per-service host-based-routing target groups. Lets terraform create the new TG before deleting the old one when service.domain is added/removed/changed, avoiding 'Target group is currently in use by a listener' on existing-stack updates. Golden fixture regenerated. Full suite: 1572 passed.

Shipped: rc db psql subcommand. Auto-discovers postgres task from rc.yml.cluster, reads POSTGRES_USER/DB/PORT from the running task def env, builds aws ecs execute-command with PAGER=cat + psql -P pager=off so output isn't mangled by less. Supports -c <SQL> for one-shot + interactive shell mode. Tests: tests/unit/test_db_psql.py (5 cases). Resolves the 'aws ecs execute-command + psql' boilerplate I had to remember manually during the sentinal debug session.

Fixed in cli_commands/deploy.py: when --dry-run is set, dispatch_if_v2 routes to 'plan' instead of 'deploy'. Shipped: detect_unmatched_health_check_path in compose_warnings.py. Plan-time scan of urls.py files in Django-shaped build contexts; warns when rc.yml services.<svc>.health_check_path doesn't appear in any of them (with leading-slash + trailing-slash variants tried). Names sample routes found in the warning so user can correct the rc.yml. Tests: tests/unit/test_compose_warnings_health_check.py (5 cases). Real start-simpli pattern (rc.yml /api/health/ vs real /api/v1/health/) would now warn at plan time.

Shipped post-rollout ECS event watcher in provider/ecs/provider.py. After _force_new_deployments, polls service events for up to RC_POST_ROLLOUT_WATCH_S (default 60s) for ResourceInitializationError / 'unable to retrieve secret' / CannotPullContainerError / IAM-not-authorized patterns. Captures pre-roll events as baseline so stale events don't false-trigger. Surfaces matched errors as a clear WARN with offending service + AWS message + suggested fix (attach inline policy granting GetSecretValue on <project>/* ARNs). Tests in tests/unit/test_provider_ecs/test_post_rollout_watcher.py (4 cases). Conftest opts all tests out by default (RC_POST_ROLLOUT_WATCH_S=0); the 4 watcher tests override via monkeypatch. Full suite: 1588 passed in 42s.

Shipped: heartbeat wrapping for both phases of provider.exec. (1) The 5-min wait loop that polls list_tasks + describe_tasks for ExecuteCommandAgent readiness now emits 'waiting for service X to be exec-ready (elapsed=Ns)' every 30s. (2) The actual aws ecs execute-command subprocess call now also emits 'executing in X (elapsed=Ns)' so SSM-plugin / network hangs are visible instead of silent. Honors RC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_S (default 30s). Skipped when wait_budget=0 (test paths). Tests still pass: 237 provider_ecs + 1595 full suite. Doesn't address the deeper SSM-session-manager hang root causes (those are AWS-side or container-agent-side), but the user can now tell stuck vs progressing.
Shipped: rc emits health_check_grace_period_seconds=60 (180 with auto_on_deploy) on public services. Real-world repro from sentinal verification motivated this.

Shipped: fix_bake_bind now reads .dockerignore, skips COPY entries whose host source is excluded, surfaces them as result.skipped_dockerignored, and CLI prints a warning + 'remove dockerignore entry' hint. 4 new tests covering single-skip, prefix-match (parent OK when child ignored), no-dockerignore back-compat, and all-skipped path. 1626 unit/contract tests pass.

Shipped: detect_dev_mode_command in compose_warnings.py catches uvicorn --reload, gunicorn --reload, manage.py runserver, flask run --debug, npm run dev, yarn dev, next dev, webpack-dev-server, rails s without -e production. Shipped: cli._warn_on_rc_yml_ambiguity scans cwd for rc.yml + rc.*.yml siblings and emits a stderr nudge listing them when 2+ exist and no -c flag was passed. Doesn't block — just makes the implicit choice visible. 5 new tests.

Shipped: extended _watch_post_rollout_errors to count 'Health checks failed' / 'is unhealthy in target-group' events per service. 3+ in the watch window triggers a separate 'flap loop detected' diagnostic with three common causes (grace period too short, app crashing on startup, wrong containerPort) + a copy-pasteable aws logs tail command. 2 new tests covering the flap detection and the false-positive guard for normal rolling deploys (1 unhealthy event = drain, not flap).

Shipped: defensive no-cache sentinel. Any rc fix subcommand (bake-bind-mount-source, django-tls, nginx-conf) drops .rc/no-cache-next-build via no_cache_state.mark_no_cache(). _build_and_push_images consumes the sentinel via consume_no_cache() and sets ImageBuildSpec.no_cache=True for every service. ImageBuilder honors no_cache by dropping cache_from + adding --no-cache flag. 9 new tests (no_cache_state + builder no_cache behavior). Sentinel auto-deletes after consume so subsequent builds use cache normally. 1665 unit/contract tests pass.

(2) provider:1422 + 1447 silent returns in _watch_post_rollout_errors when AWS describe_services fails (baseline + mid-poll) → now emit WARN before returning, so users know the post-rollout watcher didn't run. Shipped: _ecs_cfg(ctx) helper centralizes the bespoke '(ctx.provider_config or {}).get("ecs") or {}' chain that was repeated 8 times in provider.py. Resolved by rc-e5u.38 (closed earlier this session). _detect_orphan_secret_keys_v2 in _secrets_push_v2 now flags keys present in SM but NOT in any task def's secrets[] entries — exactly the symptom this bead describes (DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS added to SM blob, container's env stayed empty because no secrets[] reference). Warning fires automatically after every rc secrets push and points users at 'rc deploy --no-build' to re-emit the task def.

Resolved by rc-e5u.36.6 (closed earlier this session). The bead's specific complaint was 'migrate FAILED because hook hit a stale task before force-roll has converged'. _wait_for_services_stable now lives inside _run_auto_on_deploy_hooks (called from BOTH dispatch_if_v2 and run_auto_on_deploy_hooks_for_path), so hooks now wait for rolloutState=COMPLETED before exec'ing — they land on the new task def, not the old one. The remaining 'fresh-stack secrets-not-yet-pushed' edge case is a config issue that rc up handles via _detect_empty_file_secrets + auto-push; rc deploy users on a brand-new stack should run rc up (or push secrets first) — separate from this bead's timing complaint.
